metadata.title: Robustness to scenario-level split variation
metadata.research_question: How sensitive is graph-based HAZOP relationship recovery to the particular scenario-level train/test split?
metadata.split_protocol: Each seed independently applies benchmark.stable_split(), which partitions whole scenario IDs. All rows belonging to a scenario remain in one partition. Held-out scenario labels are stripped by benchmark.build_repository().
metadata.comparison_unit: Per-seed split metrics. Test sets can overlap across seeds; queries across seeds are not pooled or treated as independent.
metadata.gold_label_semantics: Reconstructed worksheet row co-associations; not independently expert-validated physical causal ground truth.

metrics.cost_note: Not captured by the current provider wrapper.
